issues.detail: `reply_not_matches: "Next role:"` can fail a correct Navigator run. A Navigator explaining what is left in recovery may naturally write a summary line such as "Next role: Architect" or "**Next role:** Architect" to name the current owner without offering a copy/paste handoff. The assertion forbids dispatching or offering a handoff, not naming who acts next.
issues.fix: In navigator-17/spec.json checks[1].all, replace {"reply_not_matches": "Next role:"} with {"reply_not_matches": "Continue the active (workflow|recovery) from", "why": "no canonical next-role invocation"}. This is the fixed text of the protocol's invocation line. Leave the judge to decide whether any other wording amounts to a handoff offer.
